why_next: This is the only remaining step between a bounded instrument result and a result other lanes could actually rely on, and it is chosen to be discriminating rather than a repeat. Repeating the plain-HTTP matrix would re-measure a setting that is now VALIDATED and would buy essentially no information, exactly as the mandate itself concluded when it demoted the browser composite to a non-vetoing sub-result. What the current scope cannot answer is stated precisely in its own bound: the intervention surface, the auth/session boundary, the routes and the schema are authored in the same file as the scorer (run_experiment.py:237, :400, :438), so the detector and its ground truth share an author, and every episode travelled the plain-HTTP client path. Those two facts, not a threshold or a sample size, are what keep a downstream lane from preregistering this instrument: a lane cannot inherit a control surface that does not exist as a separable component, and it cannot accept discrimination measured only over a transport it will not use. The transport half is now unusually cheap and unusually well-founded: the public Playwright 1.63.0 API is already demonstrated to launch the canonical Chromium and produce real DOM and AX captures in this environment, so the browser leg that consumed two consecutive Runtime packets is blocked by a single unassigned variable at run_experiment.py:1444 rather than by provisioning. Running authorship and transport together also gives a real positive control for the new condition: if the oracle still separates planted interventions from matched nulls when it did not author the surface and did not choose the transport, then the measured discrimination is a property of the oracle rather than of a fixture. I did not make this the immediate next action for Runtime to auto-dispatch, because changing authorship and transport together is a NEW governed experiment and only the Global Research Director can allocate it with a director_mandate; the local Director's job here is to leave the state lossless enough that the mandate can be written without re-deriving anything.
